title: PinGER: Token-Efficient Generative Retrieval with Semantic IDs
abstract: arXiv:2610.33435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative retrieval replaces nearest-neighbor search with token-by-token decoding of an item's semantic ID (SID). But existing SID-based methods primarily use L levels of tokens sequentially to represent each item in the input history. As a result, a fixed context window holds L times fewer items than it would with one embedding per item. We present PinGER, a generative retriever deployed at Pinterest that retains SID outputs while making input histories compact, built on three ideas. (1) An asymmetric attention mask over interleaved SID and dense tokens lets later items attend only to the dense ones, so the model is supervised at every SID position in training yet serves one token per item while computing the same function. (2) Generation is controllable through goal-conditioned outputs, reinforcement learning, and a prefix-diversity penalty, which together steer retrieval toward surface-specific goals and diverse candidates. translated_title: PinGER：基于语义ID的令牌高效生成式检索
translated_abstract: 生成式检索通过逐令牌解码物品的语义ID（SID）来取代最近邻搜索。但现有的基于SID的方法主要使用L层令牌按顺序表示输入历史中的每个物品。因此，固定的上下文窗口所能容纳的物品数量比每个物品使用一个嵌入表示时少了L倍。我们提出了PinGER，这是部署在Pinterest上的一种生成式检索器，它在保留SID输出的同时使输入历史更加紧凑，其构建基于三个想法：（1）在交错的SID令牌与稠密令牌上使用非对称注意力掩码，使后续物品只能关注稠密令牌，这样模型在训练时能在每个SID位置都获得监督信号，但在服务时每个物品只需处理一个令牌，同时计算相同的函数。（2）通过目标条件输出、强化学习和前缀多样性惩罚实现可控生成，三者共同将检索引导至表面特定的目标和多样化的候选结果。（3）一种ser……
tldr: PinGER是Pinterest部署的令牌高效生成式检索器，通过在交错的SID与稠密令牌上使用非对称注意力掩码实现输入历史压缩，并结合目标条件输出、强化学习和前缀多样性惩罚实现可控生成，在保留语义ID输出的同时大幅提升了上下文窗口的物品容量。
en_tdlr: PinGER is a token-efficient generative retriever deployed at Pinterest that retains semantic ID outputs while compacting input histories through an asymmetric attention mask over interleaved SID and dense tokens, combined with controllable generation via goal-conditioned outputs, reinforcement learning, and prefix-diversity penalty.
